{{Quote|Welcome to the Museum of Dark Side Antiquities! May I help you?|The museum curator, greeting guests|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
In [[3998 BBY]], [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Tetan]] [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|socialites]] [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] met the '''curator''' of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] while on a trip to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The curator escorted the Ketos through the museum's newly unveiled exhibit, ''[[The Dark Lords of the Sith]]''.
